Clear silhouette and comfortable margin all around, no cropped feet, no additional head inset or duplicates.
Style: match the official references: refined Japanese anime visual novel illustration, clean controlled linework, detailed but restrained cel shading, soft highlights, no 3D or photorealism. No scene, no scenery, no props, no weapon, no text, no watermark, no symbols floating around her.
Background: genuinely transparent alpha background with clean natural character edges, no solid color or painted checkerboard, no glow, no ground plane and no cast shadow on a background. Portrait canvas, approximately 1024 x 1536.
